objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, invalidated, reactivated and translated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name including document type abbreviation, consecutive number and title by default.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each type included in the name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document version that can be printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document status that can be printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope that can be printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity starts after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained for a document type.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version of a released document for translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which an authorized reader can see a released language version.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when a new document is created; document templates and periods can be defined for it.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Document level used for structuring and evaluation.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for checking extended validity defined for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive period defined for each document type.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation used in document names.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: document_property
objs.description: Properties of a document in which standardized and customer-specific metadata, authorizations and workflow participants are maintained.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of document attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained for a document.

objs.name: attribute
objs.description: Document property field used for metadata, references, authorizations, workflow participants and distribution.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document that belongs to a document and can be scheduled for implementation and edited.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported workflow used for release, validity extension, AKS, acknowledgement and reactivation processes.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed in workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete release tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: user
objs.description: User of DHC VISION participating in creation, release, review, acknowledgement, administration and other processes.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned directly in authorizations, distribution lists or document properties.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorizations, roles, reader groups and distribution.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role that can view approved objects and may take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role assigned to a document that receives read and write permissions and signs creation in the first workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Role with personal change rights on a document and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role that checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role responsible for the document and its content and for deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: Creator of a document, change proposal or request as explicitly described in the process.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group that retains read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document by assigning user groups or persons for distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of taking note of a document, documented and summarized for key roles.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: E-mail sent by the system to inform users about workflow tasks, releases, requests or proposal changes.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled from distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Link from a document to master data, another document or the original document for a local addition.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data that can be linked to documents, including examples such as IT applications.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be linked automatically with documents already in the system.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be linked automatically with documents already in the system.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be linked automatically with documents already in the system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Creation of a new document in the system by attachment of a new information object and selection of document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Selection of the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Selection of one or more defined templates when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Creation of a pure object cover for uploading external files or documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Uploading external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generation of a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_property
evts.description: Editing of document properties to maintain metadata, authorizations and workflow participants.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintenance of standardized and customer-specific metadata for a document.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Editing of document content using the implemented editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Saving a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system-supported conversion of a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display of the current converted document version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group-related and person-related authorizations in the control category.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assignment of participants in the release process through document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Adding additional information to a document by attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Direct release and publication of additional information via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Direct deletion of additional information.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Adding a controlled attachment to a document by attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking an attachment for archiving and archiving it with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiation of the approval process after document creation, maintenance and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator step of the workflow.

evts.name: complete_review_task
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete their review task positively or reject it.

evts.name: complete_release_task
evts.description: Assigned releasers complete their release task positively or reject it.

evts.name: cancel_workflow
evts.description: Workflow is canceled for all subsequent participants immediately after first rejection during review or release.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature documented for the released version.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final release of the document after required workflow tasks are completed.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revision of a valid and released document resulting in a new editing version.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of a new document version due to revision, triggering changes, scheduled change proposals or reactivation.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a change proposal for a document by employees with author rights.

evts.name: notify_document_author
evts.description: E-mail notification to the author of the underlying document when a change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Scheduling a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completion of a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creation of a validity extension request 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of a request for validity extension.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declaration of additional validity for the document.

evts.name: update_valid_until
evts.description: Updating the document valid until date by the default value of 3 years.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Deletion of the request for validity extension after additional validity or release of a revised version.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatic termination of the validity extension process when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Creation of a request for AKS for a selected document by users with write access.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatic start of the workflow for processing a request for AKS.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declaration that a document is out of force, giving the last valid approved version that status.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archiving of invalidated documents and attachments by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Deletion of existing edited versions after declaration of out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physical deletion of archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Creation of a request for reactivation in the provided folder with selection of the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatic workflow start after request for reactivation is created.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirmation of reactivation by the creator of the request.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of invalidated documents through the reactivation process.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivation of attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintenance of distribution lists for each document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: E-mail notification to directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic e-mail request to persons and users of assigned user groups to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: summarize_acknowledgement
evts.description: Overview of unconfirmed acknowledgements and notification when all maintained persons have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Filling user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups per document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Execution of role-specific evaluation reports and searches with selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported check of a translated version.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported release of a translated version.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specification of the clients in which a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_addition
evts.description: Creation of a new document in a client to describe a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Creation or maintenance of a reference from a document to master data, another document or the original document.
